runtime.purpose: The documented SGLang0.5.20/AITER2cb3d175/FlyDSL0.4.0 stack is the intended qualification runtime. This image is a reference, not a mandatory digest; actual image and device require their own GLM task-validator PASS.

input_policy.hidden_and_expert_weights: independent seeded BF16 standard normal values, following upstream test_moe_2stage
input_policy.weight_quantization: per_1x32_f4_quant Even mode2 E8M0, packed nearest-even E2M1; weight (16,16) preshuffle and e8m0 scale shuffle
input_policy.routing: FP32 standard-normal global256 logits; softmax, unique top8, renormalize selected8; append global shared expert256 with coefficient1
input_policy.shared_coefficient_scope: Synthetic local-call policy; not an inferred serving coefficient or collective normalization.
input_policy.ep_mask: rank0 routed IDs0..63 plus shared ID256; global-to-local cumulative binary map
input_policy.fresh_state: seed29 replaces all activation/routing values in the existing public storages; same prepared weights
input_policy.quantization_scope: Generated weight values follow the checkpoint-declared EVEN format policy. Runtime activation quantization is the pinned public fused_moe path, which differs from the checkpoint input_tensors EVEN declaration.

numerical_contract.reference: independent FP32 PyTorch dequantization and two projections; FP32 SiLU*up goes directly into the selected fused-stage1 MXFP4 quantization
numerical_contract.activation_scale: input: E8M0 ceil_pow2(amax/6) per32; intermediate: exponent(((amax_f32_bits+0x400000)&0xFF800000))-2, clamped at E8M0 code0
numerical_contract.output: complete local BF16[M,H] result including zero contribution from remote experts
